approach: Independent snapshot-history approach. It reads only train.parquet and, for test, val.parquet labels from the task directory, using the supplied time, entity, and target columns. Complete-timestamp causal entity rates, recent outcomes, activity/recency, snapshot prevalence, and calendar features feed a deterministic single-thread ExtraTrees/logistic ensemble; row_id restores query-row order.
command: python solution.py --task-dir PATH --time-col NAME --entity-col NAME --target-col NAME --split val|test --out FILE
